do we not see a world where the admin would want a looser profile as the baseline than the default? I think this should only be a two way intersection:
( base_profile ? base_profile : runtime default ) | oci_ref
Agreed, changed to the two-way intersection: a `Localhost` base replaces the runtime default. #142511, cri-o/cri-o#10382, and the docs follow; the KEP gets updated with the other differences.

I don't know if I agree with adding this yet... if runtime is too old to support apparmor then it should reject as unknown type, what do we gain by adding now? what if we never do it and it's there forever?
Fair, dropped. The enum has only `Unspecified` and `Seccomp` now; an unknown value is rejected as unsupported either way, so beta can add one if it needs it.
